messages.subject: Project Falcon - heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Gregory,

Draft heads of terms attached reflecting the agreed shape: enterprise value £52m on a cash-free, debt-free basis, headline equity value c.£44.6m, £2m retention in escrow, eight-week exclusivity. Clauses 9-12 (exclusivity, confidentiality) are binding; the rest subject to contract. If you're content we'll send to Castle & Vane.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
